status: Figures for the Admin Area finder (MS/Engines/AdminArea). R figures are written in the Pakistani books (page cited); U figures are US doctrine cited where they are silent; E figures are proposals for the user to correct. The New Logistic System (CSC Handout) was not read (password).

basisKey.R: Written in a Pakistani book (SO's Handbook 2019 Sec 10 / 13, Logistics Support in the Field, GSP Inf Div in Battle, IBB, Mech Inf Bn in Battle, SD Vol I / II), page cited
basisKey.U: US doctrine cited (ATP 4-90 2026, ATP 3-21.20 2017, FM 63-21 1990 and others listed under sources), checked against the copies kept in Material/Literature/2. Online
basisKey.E: Decision or proposal: no figure in the books or the open doctrine searched (listed under 'Looked for in'); the reason is given, with any book words it rests on as context. 'decided' = taken for the tool on the user's instruction (17 Nov 2026), to be replaced when a book figure is found
basisKey.M: Method setting of the finder: how it searches, how much data it needs before it judges, how it orders the list. Not a military rule; it never makes a site pass a check it would fail. The reason is given, and a test where one can show it
basisKey.S: A published civil standard (UN Degree of Urbanisation), page cited

baa.label: Bde Admin Area (BAA)

frontM.src: No BAA size in the Pakistani books. Worked out: in US doctrine a BSA is 4-7 km across inside a DSA of 7-10 km (FM 63-2 p A-4), a third to a half of its area; the same share of the DAA (15-20 map squares, SOH Sec 10 p 1054) is 5-10 km2. 2.5 x 2.5 km (6.25 km2) taken: in that band and below the 8-10 map squares a whole Inf Bde concentrates in (SOH Sec 10 p 1065). Enter the vehicles to size it at 50 per km2

beyond.src: No rule names enemy artillery for the DAA. It lies behind the brigade admin areas, which are beyond his medium guns (ATP 4-90 p 27; the US DSA lies behind the BSA, FM 63-2 p 1-4), and its book distances in defence (48 km) and withdrawal (33 km) are beyond every Indian medium gun. In the advance the book puts it 15-20 km back (SOH Sec 10 p 1055), inside medium range: there the row fails and says so, a risk the book accepts to keep up with the advance
